findings.claim: Unsubscribe links carry a plain sequential id and no token, so they can be forged for any user.
If Resend errors halfway through the loop, the next run sends the same alert email again to everyone processed before the failure because last_run_at is only updated at the end of the batch.
findings.evidence: await sql`update saved_searches set last_run_at = now() where active`;

findings.claim: A 15-minute cron cannot meet the 30-minute alert target when one run overlaps the next.
